_README: Ratchet baselines for scripts/check-ui-reality.ts. Each count may only go DOWN. Lower a number when you fix something, so the gain is locked in. Raising one is allowed but must be deliberate and explained in the PR - it means shipping a control that does nothing, a screen with invented data, a page nobody can reach, or dead code.
